mapper.select: SELECT s.SIMULATION_ID AS simulationId, ep.USER_ID AS userId, fs.CURRENT_PREP_MONTHS AS currentPrepMonths, s.EXPECT_PREP_MONTHS AS expectPrepMonths, ep.TARGET_EMPLOYMENT_DATE AS targetEmploymentDate, ep.LIVING_FUND_THRESHOLD AS livingFundThreshold FROM EMPLOYMENT_PREPARATIONS ep LEFT JOIN ( SELECT fs1.* FROM SNAPSHOT fs1 INNER JOIN ( SELECT USER_ID, MAX(SNAPSHOT_CREATED_AT) AS max_created FROM SNAPSHOT WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} GROUP BY USER_ID ) fs_max ON fs1.USER_ID = fs_max.USER_ID AND fs1.SNAPSHOT_CREATED_AT = fs_max.max_created ) fs ON ep.USER_ID = fs.USER_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT s1.* FROM SIMULATION s1 INNER JOIN ( SELECT USER_ID, MAX(SIMULATION_ID) AS max_id FROM SIMULATION WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} GROUP BY USER_ID ) s_max ON s1.USER_ID = s_max.USER_ID AND s1.SIMULATION_ID = s_max.max_id ) s ON ep.USER_ID = s.USER_ID WHERE ep.USER_ID = #{userId}
